Cc: ops@clevercart.com, david.li@clevercart.com
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden throughput drop + 503 spike (live now)

Marissa —

We're seeing a large throughput degradation on our production inference traffic starting ~16:30 PDT. P90 latency climbed from ~180ms to >2.5s and we're returning 503s for ~7% of requests. This is impacting checkout flows across several merchants. Our team opened a bridge but wanted to escalate to you directly: this is user-impacting and execs are already pinging.

What we need:
- Quick explanation of what the root cause is (if known)
- ETA for mitigation / temporary workaround
- Outline of follow-up RCA and corrective actions with owners

Attached are a sample traces export and SRE notes so far. We're keeping the bridge open and can jump on a call.

Thanks —
Lauren

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Triage findings — transient KV cache invalidation + autoscaler interaction

Team — quick summary from the bridge/metrics:
- At ~16:28 PDT we observed a burst of slightly malformed keepalive frames from a third-party edge (trace id sample attached). The runtime's KV cache invalidation logic coincided with a scheduled autoscaler evaluation which temporarily reduced shard concurrency.
- The intersect of cache misses + reduced concurrency amplified token generation latency and caused backpressure that surfaced as 503s in the proxy layer.
- We've confirmed no data exfiltration and the issue is not model corruption; it's an orchestration boundary timing problem.

Immediate actions taken (completed):
1) Rolled back the autoscaler evaluation window for your dedicated pool to the prior stable window (rollback id: asg-rollback-311).
2) Applied a transient KV cache grace (200ms) patch to the runtime to prevent simultaneous invalidation during autoscaler operations.
3) Increased pool concurrency by +15% for the affected shards — traffic has largely returned to baseline.

Next steps (RCA + exec deliverable):
- Produce formal RCA doc and remediation plan by EOD tomorrow (Kim will lead).
- Draft 90-day remediation roadmap with milestones (Karthik) and test regression harness for edge cases (Ben).

Please prepare a concise exec write-up for Lauren and their CIO. I'll validate technical sections.

- Jonas
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft RCA + corrective list (internal review)

Folks — attached is the draft RCA packet I'm circulating for internal review. Highlights:
- Root cause: orchestration timing window between autoscaler evaluation and KV cache invalidation triggered by malformed keepalives from vendor edge.
- Contributing factors: insufficient guard-rails for concurrency drop during autoscaler events; no regression test for simultaneous cache churn + autoscale.
- Customer impact: sustained p95/p99 inflation and ~7% 503s over 32 minutes affecting checkout across 3 merchants.

Proposed corrective actions (owners & target dates):
A) Short-term (<=72h): formalize autoscaler evaluation rollback policy (owner: Karthik), backfill monitoring alert for rapid cache-invalidation events (owner: Jonas).
B) Medium-term (30 days): add a KV cache grace interval toggle and expand e2e regression harness to include malformed edge frames (owner: Ben).
C) Long-term (90 days): autoscaler state machine hardening and operator training + policy docs (owner: EngInfra).

I've attached the RCA PDF and a 90-day roadmap workbook. Please review and send comments by 16:00 PDT today so I can finalize the external-facing packet.

[Attachment: clevercart-rca-draft-20280531.pdf]
[Attachment: 90-day-remediation-roadmap.xlsx]

—Kimberly
Director, Platform Reliability

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive summary + 90-day remediation roadmap (CleverCart)

Lauren —

Thanks again for patience while we investigated. Attached is an executive summary version of the RCA and a proposed 90-day remediation roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and verification criteria. Short summary up front:
- What happened: a timing interaction between our autoscaler evaluation and KV cache invalidation, triggered by malformed keepalive frames from an upstream edge, resulted in a transient concurrency drop and amplified cache-miss latency.
- Impact: elevated p95/p99 latency and ~7% 503s for ~32 minutes across production shards. No customer data exposed.
- Containment/mitigation: autoscaler rollback + runtime grace patch were applied during the incident and returned traffic to baseline.

Deliverables enclosed:
1) External-facing RCA (one-page executive summary + technical annex)
2) 90-day remediation roadmap (owners, milestones, test criteria)
3) JIRA epic and weekly checkpoint cadence proposal

Key commitments:
- Immediate: implement autoscaler evaluation guard and alerting in 72 hours (Karthik/Jonas).
- 30-day: regression harness expanded and KV cache grace configurable (Ben).
- 90-day: autoscaler state hardening and operator SOPs; follow-up tabletop with CleverCart execs (owner: Kimberly).

Proposed next steps:
- Exec sync: 45-minute call Wednesday 09:00 PDT—please confirm an attendee list (we recommend Lauren, David Li, Redwood Eng leadership: Kimberly + Jonas).
- Weekly checkpoints: 30-minute progress calls every Tuesday for 8 weeks.

If this plan looks good I'll finalize the packet and send over formal JIRA epics and a DocuSign acknowledgement for the executive remediation plan.

Attached: clevercart-rca-final-exec.pdf, 90-day-remediation-roadmap.xlsx

—Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
